protocol.source: Exactly the previous 376 eligible v42 classic-teacher roots, raw8. No learner roll-in ancestors.
protocol.splitRule: Group entire native encounter families (NORMAL/WEAK collapsed), union cross-family same-character decks with multiset Jaccard>=.85; hash-select ~quarter of components in each act/kind stratum. Preserve original root order within each side.
protocol.selectionRule: One global candidate for all characters: minimum macro mean over native characters, then encounter families, then root mean clipped[-40,40] pair logistic loss from the existing C# audit. Exact tie prefers linear, otherwise greater regularization. All preference kinds retained; report them separately. Zero-pair roots excluded with counts.
protocol.isolation: Fit linear foundation, vocabulary/support and factors ONLY on inner training roots; audit held-out rows through C# raw features, never through a validation-filtered vocabulary.
protocol.fullFit: After selecting one global regularization, refit factors using the unchanged full v43 export and its existing learned foundation. For linear or .001, reuse the already fitted identical full-data artifact and existing development evidence; do not repeat training or battles.
protocol.searchGate: Only the chosen full-data model receives the original five outer-development screen then remaining ten if no regression/unverified; final sealed. No role-head cherry picking.
